subsection.name: SR-2 - Supply Chain Risk Management Plan
Establish SCRM Team
description: establish a supply chain risk management team consisting of organization defined personnel, roles, and responsibilities to lead and support the following SCRM activities: organization defined supply chain risk management activities

subsection.name: SR-3 - Supply Chain Controls and Processes
Diverse Supply Base
description: employ a diverse set of sources for the following system components and services: organization defined system components and services

subsection.name: Limitation of Harm
description: employ the following controls to limit harm from potential adversaries identifying and targeting the organization supply chain: organization defined controls

subsection.name: Sub Tier Flow Down
description: ensure that the controls included in the contracts of prime contractors are also included in the contracts of subcontractors

subsection.name: Identity
description: establish and maintain unique identification of the follwoign supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with the identified system and critical system components: organization defined supply chain elements, processes, and personnel associated with organization defined systems and critical system components

subsection.name: Trakc and Trace
description: establish and maintain unique identification of the following systems and critical system components for tracking thorugh the supply chain: organization defined system and critical system components

subsection.name: Validate and Genuine and Not Altered
description: employ the following controls to validate that the system or system component received is genuine and has not been altered: organization defined controls

subsection.name: Supply Chain Integrity - Pedigree
description: employ organization defined controls and conduct organization defined analysis to ensure the integrity of the system and system components by validating the internal composition and provenance of critical or mission essential technologies, products, and services

subsection.name: SR-5 - Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods
Adequate Supply
description: employ the following controls to ensure an adequate supply of organization defined critical system components: organization defined controls

subsection.name: Assessments Prior to Selection, Acceptance, Modification, or Update
description: assess the system, system component, or system service prior to selection, acceptance, modification, or update

subsection.name: Testing and Analysis
description: employ organizational analysis, independent third party testing of the following supply chain elements, processes, and actors associated with the system, system component, or system service: organization defined supply chain elements, processes, and actors

subsection.name: Multiple Stages of System Development Life Cycle
description: employ anti tamper technologies, tools, and techniques throughout the system development life cycle

subsection.name: Anti Counterfeit Training
description: train organization defined personnel and roles to detect counterfeit system components

subsection.name: Configuration Control for Component Service and Repair
description: maintain configuration control over the following system components awaiting service or repair and serviced or repaired components awaiting return to service: organization defined system components

subsection.name: Anti Counterfeit Scanning
description: scan for counterfeit system components at organization defined frequency
